key_insight: PagedWeight dynamically quantizes MoE expert weights at runtime to balance model accuracy, GPU memory, and serving throughput as KV-cache demand grows.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical serving strategy for memory-constrained MoE LLM deployments, helping operators preserve accuracy while fitting larger batches or longer contexts.
method: Quality-aware tradeoff management between weight precision and KV-cache size
Designed for memory-sensitive MoE serving scenarios
evidence_signal: Across multiple memory-sensitive MoE serving scenarios, the method matches FP16 accuracy with up to 72.0% GPU memory savings and 1.94× higher throughput, while outperforming quantization baselines by up to 39.3% quality at similar memory budgets.
watch_item: Runtime quantization decisions add system complexity and may require careful tuning to avoid latency or quality regressions under changing workloads.
paper_title: PagedWeight: Efficient MoE LLM Serving with Dynamic Quality-Aware Weight Quantization
